[[Tahlkora]] insists that she overheard [[Varesh]] and [[General Kahyet]] plotting to weaken [[Istan]]. You infiltrate the [[corsair]]s to investigate these claims and make your way through the bogs to rendezvous with Kahyet and prevent a deal from going ahead.  

== Mission information ==

=== Requirements ===
* All Nightfall characters must have accepted the reward for [[Following the Trail]].
* [[Tahlkora]] must be present in the party.

=== Objectives ===
Find [[General Kahyet]]. Prevent her from striking a deal with [[Ironfist]], the corsair captain.
* ADDED: Eliminate Ironfist's envoy and crew.
* ADDED: Steal the corsair garb.
* ADDED: Pass through the [[Kourna]]n check point.
* ADDED: Follow [[Captain Besuz]] to the meeting with Kahyet.
* ADDED: Kill Kahyet.
* *BONUS* Clear [[Lahtenda Bog]] of [[Rinkhal Monitor|rinkhal monitors]].
* You have [5...0] of 5 rinkhal monitors remaining.

== Walkthrough ==
Lahtenda Bog is a maze but [[Captain Besuz]] will show you the way once you find him. Turn right at the first opportunity to find  [[Ironfist's Envoy]] - kill the corsair group to take their clothes as a [[Corsair (disguise)|disguise]]. Head southeast until you find Captain Besuz's roadblock. Talk to the captain to continue, he will now lead you to the rendezvous point with [[General Kahyet]]. Follow him and defeat the various groups of [[Skale]] on your path. You will soon see a camp and a narrow path where a stampede of Skale will run through, use it as a choke point. As you get closer to the ruins, a group of [[Harpy|Harpies]] will [[spawn]] too. Once you reach the rendezvous, General Kahyet will arrive and trigger a brief conversation; kill her to complete the mission.

=== Bonus ===

The bonus requires the party to kill 5 [[Rinkhal Monitor]]s, a simple but time consuming task.
# The first is south of Ironfist's Envoy.
# The second is after Captain Besuz's roadblock and to the east, inside a natural cave with ancient relics.
# The third is very close to the second, just northeast of it.
#:Now return to Besuz who will wait for you to proceed. Follow him until you pass the three named corsairs and then when Besuz turns left, you turn right instead to find the last two Rinkhal Monitors.
# On the North side of the swamp.
# North from target 4 surrounded by Mandragor and Skale.
Finally backtrack to rejoin Besuz and finish the mission.

=== Skill recommendations ===
* [[Condition]]-removal skills since foes cause [[disease]] frequently (e.g. [[Extinguish]]). In Hard mode, the Motivation [[Henchman]] [[Sogolon]] has [[Cautery Signet]].
* [[Area of effect]] damage is useful during the Skale stampede.

=== Hard mode ===
When you reach the Corsair camp, use the top of the hill to flag heroes/henchmen before the Skale stampede begins, this provides height advantage. The Skale [[mob]] partially separates making them easier to kill.

Alternatively it is possible to head northwest before encountering the Skale stampede, followed by heading south and carefully pulling the two separate groups apart with a long or flatbow.

== Notes ==
* Non-human party members will not be [[Corsair (disguise)|disguised]] after killing Ironfist's Envoys, but this has no impact on mission progress.
* The Corsair disguise is actually a transformation as you will have another face and skin color than your own.
* If you talk to [[One-Eyed Rugger]] (one of the 3 corsair NPCs), you will become [[drunk]]. 
** The warped-screen effect persists until you complete the mission; it does ''not'' contribute to the [[Drunkard]] [[title]] nor contribute towards skills that benefit from being drunk. 
** You can remove the screen-warping by disabling the "Enable post-process effects" in the [[options panel]]. 
* Mapping the mission area ([[Lahtenda Bog]]) will contribute ~2.5% towards the Elona [[cartographer]] title.
* At the completion of this mission, you could have up to eight party members in [[Sunspear Great Hall]] (exceeding that outpost's normal party size); you can use this to [[vanquish]] the [[Plains of Jarin]]. 
** Your party will consist of its leader, the required hero ([[Tahlkora]]), and up to six others: players, heroes (maximum of 3 per player will be [[teleport]]ed), or henchmen (however, only Kihm, Herta, Sogolon, and Gehraz will show up; the other henchmen do not appear in the great hall).
** An easier solution is to ask [[Dockmaster Dimedeh]] to teleport your party of 8 from [[Dajkah Inlet (outpost)|Dajkah Inlet]] to [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] and vanquish from there.
* Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #13 of the [[Young Heroes of Tyria]] [[storybook]].

{{bug|Mercenary Heroes will always transform into a male corsair even if they are female.}}
{{bug| It is possible to pass through some of the [[Kournan Guard]] barriers before speaking to Captain Besuz. There is no benefit in doing so and requires more time than finishing the mission normally.}}
